name: Inventions
overview: Scripture reveals that all inventions and creations originate from God, who made the heavens, the earth, and all things by His power (Genesis 1:1; John 1:3). Human ingenuity, such as that demonstrated by Tubalcain as an instructor of artisans in brass and iron, is a gift within the created order (Genesis 4:22). While human creativity can be used for good, Scripture also warns of deception and subtlety apart from God’s truth (Genesis 3:1), and the Spirit of truth guides believers into all understanding, including insight into what is to come (John 16:13). Thus, inventions are ultimately under God’s sovereign design and guidance.
